description:
Create packages/proto/schemas/vrooli-events/v1/ with three proto files following established buf patterns from agent-manager/v1/:

1. **Event envelope** (envelope.proto): event_id (string), source_scenario (string), target_scenario (string), event_type (string, structured as {scenario}.{domain}.{action}.{version}), timestamp (google.protobuf.Timestamp), correlation_id (string), payload (google.protobuf.Any — first use of Any in the codebase, buf.yaml already has google/protobuf dep), metadata (map<string,string>).

2. **Typed policy rule protos** (policy.proto): AccessRule with source_pattern, target_pattern, action_pattern, effect enum (ALLOW/DENY), specificity scoring fields for segment-count evaluation (exact=3, prefix glob=2, wildcard=1, max 9); RateLimit with capacity (int64, max burst) and refill_rate (double, tokens/sec) for token bucket algorithm; CircuitBreaker with failure_threshold (int32), cooldown_seconds (int64), and state enum (CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN).

3. **SSE message types** (sse.proto): SubscriptionRequest, EventNotification, PolicySnapshot (full ruleset push for atomic cache replacement on policy changes), HeartbeatMessage (with dropped_count field for backpressure notification).

Run buf generate to produce Go/TS/Python/JS bindings. Validate generated code compiles.
name: vrooli-events-proto-schemas
title: Draft vrooli-events Proto Schemas (Envelope, Policy Rules, SSE Messages)
